email.subject: Offer of employment - DevOps Engineer
email.body:
Dear candidate,

We are pleased to offer you the position of DevOps Engineer at Verdant Grid, as set out in the attached offer letter.

To accept, please sign the letter and complete the background check form through the link in the attachment. Once the background check is complete, we'll confirm your start date and send your onboarding schedule.

We look forward to welcoming you to the team.

Kind regards,
Verdant Grid People Team
